If I had more time, I would take up sailing.
If I were you, I would wait two weeks.
What would you do with a free year?
If I have time this week, I will call him.
Right, no more work talk. If somebody gave you a free year, what would you do with it?
Honestly? If I had a free year I would take up sailing, and I would learn it properly.
Sailing. That is not the answer I expected from you.
Nobody expects it. I am tied up until seven every day, so it stays imaginary.
It is a shame. If you started now, one Saturday a month, you would be sailing by the summer.
You sound like my wife. I am in two minds about it, and I have been for about ten years.
Then sooner or later you will do it. What would you do first if you had the boat tomorrow?
I would go nowhere. I would sit on it and wind down for three hours. What about you?
I am in two minds about it, honestly.
I am tied up until about seven every day.

If you only ever ask one question at a dinner table, make it this one. If somebody gave you a free year, what would you do with it? People answer that honestly, and they answer it fast, and the reason is simple. Nothing is at stake. Nobody is being asked to commit to anything, nobody is being judged, and there is no wrong answer, so the guard comes down in about four seconds. It also works with a complete stranger, because it asks about a person without asking anything private. And here is the part I find interesting. When somebody gives you the same answer they gave three years ago, word for word, it usually means the thing is not imaginary at all. It is just waiting.

I was in two minds about it for about ten years, which is an embarrassing sentence to say out loud. Every year I told myself the same thing: if I had more time, I would do it properly. My wife finally said the obvious. If you wait for a free year you will wait for ever, and one Saturday a month is already enough. So I started, badly, on somebody else's boat, and I was terrible at it for two seasons. People ask me what I do out there now and the honest answer is mostly nothing. I sit on it and I wind down for three hours. That is not a side effect. That is the entire point.
